description: SENSE, LBT_WAIT, CONT_WAIT and LINKING in turn, one transmission per visit to LINKING, then SENSE with no timer; a later request contends afresh.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). Each S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is to SAP 5, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 (the 648000-unit default, so TTD = request time + 1296000000 ms, A-0089, A-0091), and asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095). The CAS wraps the DATA S_PDU (priority, SAP 5 to SAP 5, TTD) in a DATA C_PDU (B-0297). Each D_PDU is type 7 NON-ARQ-DATA (C-0323, C-0575) with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), address size 4, source 0.0.1.2, the whole C_PDU as its one segment (offset 0, C_PDU size = segment size, C-0343, C-0346), DELIVER IN ORDER clear (C-0333), C_PDU IDs allocated from 0 in placement order (C-0326, C-1040), and no pre-fill (D-0003). The air start of a D_PDU is the start of the block holding its first byte, preamble_ms + block x block_ms (C-1043); EOT = ceil((duration_ms - air start) / 500) (C-0104, C-0891, D-0005, D-0017), and the reception window is the same value because every copy of the C_PDU is in this transmission (C-0350, C-0352). The waveform is drc.default_speed, wn 2 long (C-0894). Slotted position 2: (2 - 1) x 3000 = 3000 ms while the last transmission is another node's (K-0081). At 38550 our transmission ends: back to SENSE, no timer, nothing queued (K-0092, K-0093, K-0064). Another node's burst from 60000 to 62000 makes the last transmission someone else's (K-0086) and its end DCD-determined (K-0070), so the request at 100000 gets LBT 30000 and again 3000 ms of contention. The second C_PDU takes C_PDU ID 1 (C-0326). Both transmissions are one block, duration 5550 ms. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
